title: 5-round AES-192: Conditional MixColumns difference equality

target.description: Conditional property inside the first5 AES rounds, ending after MC5 before ARK5. The internal x1^M difference is the Section3 two-column pattern; this is not an unconditional five-round differential.

setting.key_relation: Two unknown AES-192 master keys K and K'=K XOR Delta, where Delta[0]=Delta[8]=a!=0 and the other22 bytes are0. Initial whitening is k0; round subkeys are k1,... .
setting.key_population: General unknown key pair with attacker-chosen nonzero a; b,c are actual key-dependent S-box output differences, not independently chosen subkeys.
setting.plaintext_model: Condition on Delta x1^M equal to(a,0,0,0) in columns2 and3 and zero elsewhere.

evidence.locator: Printed p.25 Section6, MixColumns relation preceding the attack
evidence.interpretation: Complete original proceedings reviewed. Source-convention boundaries, total queries across the two keys, partial output and native accounting are kept explicit.

limitations: Independent local checks cover the AES key schedule and deterministic components. Full cryptanalytic searches, resource calibration and success rates have not been reproduced.

property.statement: Under the specified first-round internal difference, (Delta x5^M)[4]=(Delta x5^M)[5] holds deterministically.
property.quantifier: For every internal pair and standard related-key schedule satisfying the input condition.
property.scope: Before MC5, column1 has difference(0,0,0,N) with N!=0. Equal1 coefficients in the first two rows of the last MixColumns column yield equal nonzero outputs.

parameters.name: Equality probability
parameters.meaning: Conditional on the first-round internal difference and Table2.

validation.description: Section6 proof and512 independent AES forward examples; the source's wrong-key2^-8 equality heuristic is distinct from this exact conditional identity.
